subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters C, L, O, U, R and F. Two positions of the same dice are shown in the given figures. Which face is opposite to face L?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fd4fd425cac54bca773a8210b43fff0b2bb6279cbc23f366c4889aaf367301a.png]
solution:
Logic: If two dice have the same face value in the given image then their clockwise or anticlockwise wise number are known as opposite numbers in dice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn010.adda247.com/761f0c87-b016-4417-82a4-ef7c5f51f014.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn010.adda247.com/3b3f9a90-cee9-4620-bca6-464d579eacfa.png] 

R is opposite face of L

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
